# Probing Genomic Foundation Models with Splice-Variant Perturbations
Author: Marcel V. Alavi

Preprint: (link)
Content: This repository contains the scoring scripts and variant datasets of the study.


## Disclaimer
**Predictions generated by these models and scripts are for research purposes only and are NOT intended for clinical diagnosis or decision-making.**

## Repository layout

```
Probing-genomic-foundation-models-2026/
├── README.md
├── LICENSE.txt
├── models/
│   ├── 1_spliceai/
│   │   └── 2c8_spliceai.py                  # API call
│   ├── 2_alphagenome/
│   │   ├── 2c8_alphagenome_junctionscorer.py  # API call
│   │   └── 2c8_alphagenome_splicescorer.py    # API call
│   ├── 3_flashzoi/
│   │   ├── environment.txt                  # VM hardware, Python/CUDA versions
│   │   └── 2c8_flashzoi.py                  # 32-bp bin, 22 ENCODE tracks, Fwd-RC avg
│   ├── 4_ntv3/
│   │   ├── environment.txt                  # VM hardware, Python/CUDA versions
│   │   ├── 2c8_ntv3_post.py                 # post-trained, Fwd & RC
│   │   └── 2c8_ntv3_pre.py                  # pretrained, Fwd & RC
│   ├── 5_evo2/
│   │   ├── 2c8_evo2_fwd.py                  # API call, Fwd
│   │   └── 2c8_evo2_rc.py                   # API call, RC
│   └── 6_genos10b/
│       ├── a100_environment.txt             # VM hardware (A100), Python/CUDA versions
│       ├── blackwell_environment.txt        # VM hardware (RTX PRO 6000), Python/CUDA versions
│       ├── 2c8_genos10b_fwd.py              # Fwd
│       ├── 2c8_genos10b_rc.py               # RC
│       └── 2c8_genos10b_clinvar.py          # API call
└── data/
    ├── multigene_variants.csv               # Multi-gene set
    ├── opa1_variants.csv                    # OPA1 LOVD corpus
    └── targets_human.txt                    # Borzoi/flashzoi track IDs
```
